facts.subject: char:rafi
facts.statement: Rafi remained on the high granite ledge after the rescue attempt.

facts.subject: item:route_book
facts.statement: Jun put the route book into Rafi’s dry bag before climbing the last step.

facts.subject: org:expedition
facts.statement: They collected five litres of rainwater and then used two, taking the measured supply from eighteen litres to twenty-one.

facts.subject: char:jun
facts.statement: Rafi appointed Jun acting route leader for the exposed traverse.

facts.subject: char:rafi
facts.statement: Rafi’s bruised right shin was stiff, but he could put his weight on that leg.

facts.subject: item:canoe
facts.statement: They hauled the canoe onto the high granite ledge with the hand line.

facts.subject: char:eamon
facts.statement: Eamon died on the ledge after the rock strike; Rafi and Jun witnessed his final breath and could not revive him.

facts.subject: place:high_traverse
facts.statement: Jun’s completed traverse established that the high route was passable that day.
facts.temporalScope: 仅确认Jun完成穿越时的当日可通行性；非官方开放，非未来通行保证。

facts.subject: item:route_book
facts.uncertainReason: Explicitly a character’s suspicion without independent confirmation.
facts.statement: Jun suspected the repaired stitch marked a removed leaf, but no torn edge proved it.
facts.recordPolicy: Optional uncertain world proposition; recording only the suspects cognition is also acceptable.

claims.speaker: char:jun
claims.content: The whistle must be the relief boat.
claims.note: Rumour, conjecture, preference, joke or promise stays a claim, never an automatic fact.

claims.speaker: char:rafi
claims.content: Twenty-one litres, including what we collected.
claims.note: Only the current numerical balance is corroborated; any future ability or intention remains prospective.

cognitions.content: Jun can lead the remaining traverse.
cognitions.note: Confirmed epistemic attitude, not objective truth of its content.

cognitions.content: The repaired stitch corresponds to a missing route-book leaf.
cognitions.note: Confirmed epistemic attitude, not objective truth of its content.

cognitions.content: The second cairn leads to a dead end.
cognitions.note: Explicitly former and already corrected within this chapter. Original formation time is unknown; no active erroneous belief is required.

cognitions.content: The gap beside the second cairn leads to the passable high traverse.
cognitions.note: The explicitly evidenced correction is active; the former mistake is historical.

relations.statement: Rafi followed Jun’s chosen bearing without taking the route book back to overrule her.

hooks.statement: Jun found an old cut arrow beneath the second cairn’s black stone, pointing towards the high traverse.
A numbered depot stamp crossed the red thread, connecting the repair to an old inventory but naming no repairer.
The same unexplained two-note whistle sounded beyond the flooded bend while they secured the canoe.

mustNotRecord.statement: Jun planned to contact the relief boat from the landing; she sent no message from the ledge.
mustNotRecord.reason: An intention is not a completed event. Only this source sentence is restricted; a separately evidenced later completion remains valid.

mustNotRecord.statement: If Eamon had reached cover sooner he might have lived, but this possibility did not undo his death.
mustNotRecord.reason: The conditional/counterfactual antecedent is not an actual event.

mustNotRecord.statement: Rafi briefly imagined Eamon adjusting the load behind him, then recognised the image as grief, not a living companion.
mustNotRecord.reason: A dream, imagination or grief image is not present-world canon.

uncertainties.statement: The old cut arrow suggested an intended route, but did not reveal who had cut it or when.
uncertainties.note: Omit the speculative world proposition or retain it only as uncertain; no invented identity, date or mechanism.
